name: sdd:spec-template: the generated spec keeps its structure
prompt: Invoke the sdd:spec-template skill, then write a phase spec for Phase 1 of the PRD in this repo to .specs/docs/specs/phase-1_http-surface.md. Follow the template. Write the file and stop; you do not need to print it.

graders.why: the status header is what makes a document readable cold; the atlas rates it above every surveyed alternative
the Tasks Summary table is a required structure, not decoration
a dated progress log is the thing that tells a human where work stands weeks later
the spec must carry per-task detail for task generation to expand later
a spec without acceptance criteria cannot be verified
